latest.title: System 1 model workflows in AWS - overview and implementation, part 1: System 1-driven Step Functions human escalation workflow
latest.description: System 1 is a new paradigm in the world of AI and one of the hottest topics so far, but how do you bring one to your workflows while retaining complete control over the model, hosting and costs?Jev was the first, however now open-source alternatives exist like Decider-2B or Laya. In this post we will learn how you can deploy a Step Functions workflow in AWS that decides based on the human input if the human escalation is needed or if the LLM can handle the response safely

All scores are local and unofficial.
